chapter: String bands, serenading and violin players
title: Fiddle players: Peter Bocage, Manuel Manetta, Freddie Keppard
summary: Dawson names Peter Bocage and others as good violinists, says Freddie Keppard started on violin, and that these men all read music at sight.
